# ctxcap
Diagnose repository context for coding agents: rank instruction and skill file sizes, find stale references, flag recognizable credentials and risky execution flags, and list configured MCP server names.
Run `npx -y ctxcap why` for the diagnosis. File counts are approximate; skill use is client-dependent, and live MCP tool-schema costs require runtime data. ctxcap never launches configured MCP servers.
The CLI also measures budgets, emits JSON/SARIF, and can print a reviewed cleanup plan. The GitHub Action is an optional reporting and enforcement surface.
Once installed, ctxcap makes no runtime network calls or telemetry. A cold npx invocation may download the package from npm.
